title: Python List Comprehensions
description: List comprehensions offer a shorter syntax when you want to create a new list based on the values of an existing list.
example: newlist = [x for x in fruits if "a" in x]

challenges.title: Square Numbers
challenges.exercise: Create a list of squares for numbers 0-4 using list comprehension. Print it.
challenges.solution:
squares = [x*x for x in range(5)]
print(squares)

challenges.title: Filter Evens
challenges.exercise: Given list [1, 2, 3, 4, 5], create a new list with only even numbers using list comprehension. Print it.
challenges.solution:
nums = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
evens = [x for x in nums if x % 2 == 0]
print(evens)
